criteria.requirement: Extend existing JSONL adapter with duplicate_headers="last"|"error"|"suffix" via formatter kwargs. Default last preserves old output; error rejects duplicate names before consuming a row; suffix creates deterministic collision-free names _2,_3,... while reserving every original name so real columns such as a_2 are not overwritten. Materialize one-shot headers once, keep row width validation and both unicode modes, preserve input header sequence and per-call formatter defaults. Explicit policies require text names.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
